source: docs/SEO/harvests/en.json (3,653 unique US Google-autocomplete queries, harvested 2026-07-06) + 18 live SERP samples (WebSearch, 2026-07-06). Research SoT: docs/SEO/demand-map-en.md

titlePattern.topicType: "<Dominant type query, keyword-led> – Free Printable PDF" — the harvest shows the same 3 qualifiers dominate every worksheet-class query in the US market: printable, free, pdf. All three are honest (everything is free, every deck has a printable PDF). Keyword leads; qualifiers trail after an en-dash. ≤51 chars before the " · LessonCraftStudio" suffix.
titlePattern.topicTheme: "<Theme demand-noun> Worksheets for Kids – Free Printables" — theme queries formulate as '<theme> worksheets for <grade|kids>' (never '<theme> printable activities'). 'for Kids' keeps the theme hub broad so it does not collide with the theme+grade deck landings, which carry the grade.
titlePattern.topicLevel: "<Grade> Worksheets – Free Printable PDF" — level hubs own the bare grade head ('worksheets for kindergarten free printable'). Subject×grade hubs own '<subject> worksheets for <grade>'; level topic pages stay subject-free.
titlePattern.intersection: "<Type demand-noun> Worksheets for <Grade> – Free PDF" (or grade-trailing '<Type> Worksheets <1st|2nd> Grade – Free PDF' where the harvest shows grade-trailing word order, e.g. 'word search 1st grade', 'telling time worksheets grade 1'). No theme — theme+type+grade belongs to deck landings.
titlePattern.notes: Every title unique across this file. 'interactive/online' is honest but reserved for meta descriptions and body copy — the online-exercise hubs (/topic/<subject>/<grade>/online) own the 'online' query class. Seasonal themes (christmas, easter, winter, spring, summer, thanksgiving, 4th_of_july, halloween) are OWNED BY THE SEASONAL HUBS shipped 2026-07-06 and are deliberately absent from singleAxis below.
